title: Throne of Glass
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: A teenage assassin is pulled from a prison mine and offered freedom if she wins a tournament as the king's champion. The contest quickly turns into a murder mystery, and the court around her is full of secrets.
readIf: you like a young-adult fantasy with a deadly competition, a mystery and a love triangle.
skipIf: you want a self-contained story, since this is the start of a long series that grows much bigger.

pairings.reason: Another young heroine forced into a lethal contest by those in power.
A sharper, more tightly plotted fantasy with a crew of dangerous young misfits.
Same author, a more romance-centered fantasy with a heroine in a magical court.
